scope: bounded action-routing and own-policy supervision experiment; no change to allocation architecture or original frozen release

rule_contract.desired_allocation: existing raw allocation and controller soft target unchanged
rule_contract.hard_beta_ceiling: max(defensive_beta, recovery_fraction * structural_max_beta), capped by existing trailing-loss and emergency limits
rule_contract.rules_only: old classifier and >5% large-transition override retained; remove any-negative-beta override and raw-target-as-hard-cap
rule_contract.net_value: predict execute-versus-hold net advantage bps; execute above zero; hard violations must repair; cold start executes target
rule_contract.recovery: Keep original first-hour model eligibility and soft current_beta_cap feature. Recovery may use the original conditional stop-clock exception, but its target beta cannot exceed existing trailing-loss or emergency ceilings; recovery never advances the clock a second time. A recovery target must increase actual marked first-hour beta; otherwise no recovery trade (HOLD may already retain exposure above the soft target).
rule_contract.fees_affordable_targets: New policies distinguish desired post-fee normalized weights z from executable pre-fee-NAV target x. Solve v=1-c*sum(abs(v*z_risky-current_risky)); x_risky=v*z_risky. Apply at open and each recovery/reset branch. Existing baseline untouched.

training.features: old 22 open-known features plus risk_clock, days_since_trade, hard_beta_cap
training.label: current execute-versus-hold net advantage plus next-target reset-cost difference; diagnostic one-session proxy
training.label_maturity: strictly before min(first test decision, fit-year Jan1 00:00 America/New_York); final2025 consumes no2026 realized outcomes; incomplete final label excluded
training.state_generation: causal own-policy trajectory; annual models fit only prior matured labels; no future outcomes in decision features
training.recent_training_comparison: 2023-2025 chronological expanding updates vs frozen 2022 policy; 2026 diagnostic only

evaluation.reused_diagnostic: 2023-2026 not clean holdout, never used for hyperparameter selection
evaluation.cost_stress: rerun own controller at each fee level, not only subtract fees from fixed path
evaluation.gates: original Stage1 development risk/cost/annual gates retained; compare active HOLD and original no-HOLD reference; report all failed variants

execution_validation.integer_shares: verify existing broker planner does not submit unchanged target quantities; separately report continuous-weight vs actual-share evidence
execution_validation.live_mutations: only SIM/shadow; no REAL; preserve original ledger/inception and pending slots

promotion: historical pass is not clean forward validation; new candidates remain not_promoted; failed candidates may be deployed read-only shadow without replacing active orders
design_corrections_before_completed_comp: Made recovery hard-tail ceiling explicit before first model fit; no observed candidate results.
Make previous-calendar-year information cutoff strict, before first new-model fit; no2026 realization in2025 final model.
